name: The Role Of The Woman
overview: Scripture reveals that the woman was created as a suitable helper for the man, designed to complement and support him (Genesis 2:18). The fall introduced sorrow and a divine order in which the husband holds a leadership role, with the woman’s desire directed toward him (Genesis 3:16). The New Testament calls wives to submit to their husbands as to the Lord, emphasizing a God-ordained structure within marriage (Ephesians 5:22; Colossians 3:18). At the same time, Galatians 3:28 affirms the equal standing of male and female in Christ, while Titus 2:3 highlights the importance of godly conduct, especially among older women who teach and encourage holiness.
